lines.text: Eve gives birth to Cain and then to Abel, who keeps sheep while Cain tills the soil.
Cain brings fruit of the soil and Abel brings the best of his flock, and the LORD favors Cain.

wrong_details.true: the LORD looked with favor on Abel and had no regard for Cain

lines.text: Cain asks Abel to go out to the field and kills him there, and the LORD says Abel's blood cries out.
The LORD curses Cain and places a crown on him, and Cain settles in the land of Nod.
Adam and Eve have a son named Seth, and Seth's son Enosh is born when men begin to call on the LORD.
